title: 5 Day Budget Tanzania Camping Safari: Tarangire, Serengeti and Ngorongoro
rank_math_title: Budget Tanzania Safari: 5-Day Serengeti Camping Trip
rank_math_desc: Budget Tanzania safari for 5 days: camping in Tarangire, two nights in the Serengeti and a game drive in Ngorongoro Crater, from Arusha.
post_content: This budget Tanzania safari is a classic camping trip through the northern circuit.
overview:
This budget Tanzania safari is a classic camping trip through the northern circuit. From Arusha you visit Tarangire's elephant herds, camp two nights in the heart of the Serengeti at Seronera public campsite, and spend a morning on the floor of Ngorongoro Crater before camping on the crater rim. A cook travels with you and prepares all meals. It suits travellers who want the Serengeti and the crater for less and are happy with simple tents.

Price: from USD 1,280 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Two nights camping in the central Serengeti
Tarangire National Park and its elephant herds
Camping crew and cook with all meals

faq.q: How much does this budget Tanzania safari cost?
faq.a: It starts from USD 1,280 per adult with a shared vehicle, based on current park and camping fees. We confirm the price for your dates when you enquire.
Public campsites have shared toilets and showers; we provide dome tents, mattresses and a cook who prepares all meals.

faq.q: Is camping in the Serengeti safe?
faq.a: Yes. Campsites are used by many safari groups every night, and guides advise on staying safe around wildlife.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire
itinerary.content: Morning pick-up in Arusha and drive to Tarangire National Park for a game drive among baobabs and elephants. Dinner and overnight at Twiga Campsite in Mto wa Mbu.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: To the Serengeti
itinerary.content: Drive over the Ngorongoro highlands into the Serengeti with a game drive on the way to Seronera. Dinner and overnight at Seronera public campsite.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park
itinerary.content: Full day of game drives in the central Serengeti, known for lions, leopards and cheetahs. Dinner and overnight at Seronera public campsite.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro
itinerary.content: Morning game drive, then drive to the Ngorongoro Crater rim. Dinner and overnight at Simba Campsite.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater to Arusha
itinerary.content: Descend into the crater for a morning game drive, then drive back to Arusha in the afternoon.

includes: Shared 4x4 safari vehicle with pop-up roof and English-speaking driver guide
Camping equipment (tents, mattresses), cook and all meals
Park entry, camping and crater fees
excludes: International flights, visa and travel insurance
Tips for guides and camp staff
Drinks unless stated, laundry and personal expenses
Optional activities not listed in the itinerary
